page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.xlarge is an x86_64 compute-oriented server instance built on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The system provides 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core under a KVM hypervisor with dedicated CPU allocation. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 1:2 (2.0 GB per vCPU). The instance contains no local storage and relies entirely on external network-attached volumes. Network connectivity provides a baseline throughput of 5 Gbps. Architectural capabilities include instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

Benchmark measurements indicate balanced single-threaded capabilities alongside limitations in parallel scaling and memory throughput. Single-core performance falls in the average bracket, evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1841.49 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1554.0. Static web serving throughput reaches 6.35 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core CPU testing shows lower relative throughput, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 3302.0 and stress-ng multi-core score of 3867.76. Memory bandwidth tests yield uncached read speeds of 30.43 GB/sec and write speeds of 25.42 GB/sec. Redis SET operations perform at 3.85 million operations per second, reflecting constraints during high-concurrency data operations.

The qualitative hardware profile balances high-clock x86 execution with moderate memory capacity. The instance offers resource efficiency for workloads that do not demand extensive memory capacity or local high-speed NVMe arrays. Recommended applications include lightweight web serving, single-threaded text or data processing, basic microservices, and general entry-level computing tasks that benefit from hardware instruction extensions like AVX-512.
